item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-33f2d223db9e528b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"On 10 April 2023, the FARDC chief of staff delivered President Félix Tshisekedi’s message to frontline troops, urging them to resist the M23, remain at their positions, obey commanders, and continue their mission of protecting the population.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.8","3B.2","3B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the report attributes the message to Tshisekedi through the army chief, but does not document the president’s operational orders, resource allocation, or resulting civilian outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The army chief explicitly presented the message as coming from President Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether the operations were defensive or whether alleged violations occurred."]},{"source_id":"SRC-da6c0fb024e0b795","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"On 8 December 2023, M23 forces occupied Mushaki and attacked FARDC and local armed groups around Bihambwe; heavy weapons fire triggered mass displacement toward Katale, Rubaya, Kinigi, Kibabi, Katoyi, and Sake.","question_ids":["2B.10","3B.6","3B.7","3B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report describes state security conditions during Tshisekedi’s presidency but does not attribute the battlefield developments or displacement directly to a presidential decision.","limitations":["The report does not establish Tshisekedi’s specific response, responsibility, or control over the forces involved."]},{"source_id":"SRC-928a3aec89b9aa7b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"On 7 October 2023, while filing his presidential candidacy, Tshisekedi promised to continue pursuing the DRC’s economic independence, summarized as Renaissance, development, and credibility, and said security was a prerequisite for development.","question_ids":["5B.1","8B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"A dated 2023 campaign statement concerning the next presidential term; it records a stated program but not implementation or results during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct statement attributed to presidential candidate Félix Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source provides no detailed timetable, budget, institutional mechanism, or independently verified outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d510e0d99eb7eba3","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In October 2023, Kasaï Central governor John Kabeya publicly declared Tshisekedi the province’s only presidential candidate and said other candidates should seek votes elsewhere; the media regulator CSAC condemned the statement as inciting tribal-regional hatred, exclusion, and discrimination, and demanded correction.","question_ids":["3B.3","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within the 2023 presidential campaign.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was made by the provincial governor, not Tshisekedi personally; the source does not report whether Tshisekedi authorized, endorsed, or remedied it.","limitations":["The evidence supports an adverse finding about an aligned public official and electoral environment, not direct personal authorship by Tshisekedi."]},{"source_id":"SRC-535a9a931cf4e292","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"At the 26 April 2023 government seminar, Tshisekedi instructed ministers to prioritize the general interest, implement the seminar’s recommendations, and pursue actions with real and visible impact; the seminar included agencies implementing the PDL-145T and reviewed field execution.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","6B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within April 2023; the record documents executive direction and a review forum, not verified completion or outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"Direct statements and instructions attributed to President Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not independently verify implementation, spending, procurement quality, or service outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-59ddc30f5a596b3d","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"On 28 December 2023, Tshisekedi’s political coordinator welcomed the preliminary CENCO-ECC election-observation report and urged rival camps to accept the December results and prepare for the 2028 election; the report said one candidate had more than half the votes and that voting proceeded appropriately in over 90% of cases.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.6","4B.8","6B.5"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within the post-election period in December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The acceptance appeal was made by Tshisekedi’s political coordinator, not by Tshisekedi personally; the quantitative election observations are attributed to CENCO-ECC.","limitations":["This source does not establish whether Tshisekedi personally accepted the result, nor does it provide the full observation report or independent adjudication of irregularities."]},{"source_id":"SRC-833bc29f2cda504e","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"On 15 November 2023, Tshisekedi chaired the final governors’ conference of his first quinquennium, intended to coordinate provincial and central governments and advise on policy and legislation; the agenda included PDL-145T progress and preparation for December elections.","question_ids":["4B.4","5B.6","6B.9","8B.5"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The conference and agenda are directly attributed to President Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not document decisions adopted, implementation compliance, or measurable results from the conference."]},{"source_id":"SRC-833bc29f2cda504e","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"At the November 2023 governors’ conference, the presidency reported more than 2.4 million internally displaced people in North Kivu, including 1.6 million around Goma, alongside intercommunal violence in Maï-Ndombe and Tshopo and escalating violence in Haut-Lomami.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.7","3B.9","6B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The conditions were reported during Tshisekedi’s 2023 presidential term.","ruler_attribution":"The figures and conflict assessment were presented by the presidency; the source does not establish personal responsibility for each conflict or the adequacy of the response.","limitations":["The source gives no program-level evidence of protective resource allocation, remedy, or causal attribution to Tshisekedi."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6a3905ef54a40524","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In November 2023, press-freedom organization OLPA warned Tshisekedi that media regulation outside Kinshasa was almost nonexistent before the election campaign; CSAC provincial offices were under-equipped, underpaid, disorganized, and lacked sufficient personnel and resources, creating conditions conducive to disinformation and tribal or ethnic hate speech.","question_ids":["3B.3","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within the 2023 election campaign period.","ruler_attribution":"OLPA addressed the warning and recommendations directly to President Tshisekedi; the reported institutional deficiencies are attributed to the state’s media-regulation system, not a specific presidential order.","limitations":["The source records an advocacy organization’s assessment and recommendations, not a completed government response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b644e4b616fca179","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 3 January 2023, the PNUD reported that the PDL-145T procurement process was advancing; its first phase in nine provinces and 54 territories was planned to build 286 health centers, 423 schools, and 54 administrative buildings, and the program was entering operationalization.","question_ids":["5B.6","6B.2","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The program was described by the acting planning minister as initiated by and embodying Tshisekedi’s presidential vision; execution was assigned to PNUD, CFEF, and BCECO.","limitations":["The source reports plans, procurement progress, and assurances rather than completed construction, service quality, or distributional outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c36a815710c138f7","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"During a March 2023 joint press conference in Kinshasa, Tshisekedi called on France to sanction Rwanda over alleged support for the M23 and described the aggression as unjustified and economically motivated; Macron responded that the DRC government needed to restore military, security, and administrative sovereignty.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.6","2B.9","2B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The call for sanctions and characterization of the conflict are direct statements attributed to President Tshisekedi; Macron’s criticism is independently attributed to the French president.","limitations":["The report notes that UN experts and Western governments supported Kinshasa’s allegation while Rwanda denied it; it does not establish the truth of every allegation or the effect of the diplomatic appeal."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3f9b899433b771a0","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In February 2023, the DRC education ministry and UNESCO presented the Pleins Feux report; it recommended continuing free basic education, reported primary-school completion rising from 32% in 2000 to 71% in 2020, documented a national reading roadmap and benchmarks in French and four national languages, and recorded validation of an action plan.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.8","8B.2","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The report and action-plan validation occurred in February 2023, while the completion trend predates 2023 and cannot be attributed solely to Tshisekedi.","ruler_attribution":"The ministry co-presented and supported the initiative; the source does not attribute the historical completion increase solely to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not provide 2023 execution data, budget details, regional distribution, or evidence that the validated action plan was implemented."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-98e416e70e4ba20d"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied documents provide limited direct evidence about nuclear, biological, cyber, AI, proliferation, fiscal, corruption, judicial, detention, and personal-integrity questions.","Several records concern conditions or actions by government agencies, provincial officials, political coordinators, or international partners; direct personal attribution to Tshisekedi is limited where the source does not identify a presidential order or response."]}
